en: Zigzag sections of Kennon Road act as inclined planes to help vehicles climb the steep mountains.
Deep treads on jeepney tires increase friction to prevent slipping on wet Philippine roads.
Maria Cristina Falls flows downward because Earth's gravity continuously pulls the water toward the ground.
Pawikan sea turtles use Earth's magnetic field to navigate across the ocean during their migrations.
A lightning flash during a thunderstorm is a massive natural discharge of static electricity.
Sunlight bends and separates into rainbow colors when it passes through raindrops after a shower.
Golden-crowned fruit bats use sound echoes to navigate and find ripe fruits in dark forests.
The black volcanic sand of Bataan beaches absorbs solar heat, becoming much warmer than the surrounding white sand.
Strong monsoon winds possess kinetic energy that spins the large blades of the Bangui wind turbines.
Tiwi Power Plant in Albay converts thermal energy from underground volcanic steam into usable electricity.
A carabao's curved horns act as levers to help it dig and lift heavy soil.
The gravitational pull of the moon causes ocean water in Manila Bay to rise and fall.
